tool.name: Coil Demo Simulator
tool.description: Generate synthetic coil voltage waveforms for MiniMak demo sequences

param.name: demo
param.label: Demo sequence
param.help: Select which coil demo to simulate. Matches the button labels in the MiniMak control GUI.
param.option: TF1 DEMO — TF Bank 1 sawtooth ramp
TF2 DEMO — TF Bank 2 sawtooth ramp
PF DEMO1 — PF Bank 1 sawtooth ramp
PF DEMO2 — Alternate PF1 / PF2 ramp (ring movement)

param.name: interval_ms
param.label: Timer interval (ms)
param.help: Period of the TimerAO tick. Default matches the UI default of 100 ms.

param.name: aoinc
param.label: Voltage step per tick (V)
param.help: Multiplied by the tick counter to give the ramp increment. Default: 0.025.

param.name: v_max
param.label: Ramp ceiling (V)
param.help: Voltage at which the ramp resets. Default: 5.0 V.

param.name: v_min
param.label: Ramp floor (V)
param.help: Voltage the ramp resets to. Default: 0.0 V.

param.name: alimit
param.label: Hardware output clamp (V)
param.help: Maximum voltage the PSU setpoint is clamped to. Default: 5.0 V.

param.name: n_ticks
param.label: Number of ticks to simulate
param.help: Total number of TimerAO firings to simulate. Default: 200 (= 20 s at 100 ms interval).

tool.help:
**Coil Demo Simulator**
Generates synthetic PSU setpoint voltage waveforms for MiniMak coil demo sequences, reproducing the exact ``TimerAO_Tick`` logic from ``FormMain.vb``.
------
**Demo sequences**
+----------+-----------+------------------------------------------------------+ | Value | GUI label | Description | +==========+===========+======================================================+ | 1 | TF1 DEMO | Sawtooth ramp on AO ch 0 (TF bank 1) | +----------+-----------+------------------------------------------------------+ | 2 | TF2 DEMO | Sawtooth ramp on AO ch 1 (TF bank 2) | +----------+-----------+------------------------------------------------------+ | 3 | PF DEMO1 | Sawtooth ramp on AO ch 0 (PF bank 1) | +----------+-----------+------------------------------------------------------+ | 4 | PF2 | Sawtooth ramp on AO ch 1 (PF bank 2) | +----------+-----------+------------------------------------------------------+ | 7 | PF DEMO2 | Alternating PF1/PF2 ramp — causes the plasma ring | | | | to move up and down the chamber centre | +----------+-----------+------------------------------------------------------+ | 8 | TF1&PF | Alternating TF1/PF1 ramp (PF1 at half amplitude) | +----------+-----------+------------------------------------------------------+
------
**Outputs**
*CSV* — one row per timer tick with columns:
- ``t_ms`` / ``t_s`` — elapsed time in ms and seconds - ``Aout0`` — ramp accumulator value - ``channel_switch`` — active coil selection flag (0 or 1) - ``V_ch0`` … ``V_ch3`` — PSU setpoint voltage for each AO channel (V)
*PNG* — step-waveform plot of the active channels for the chosen demo.
------
**PC DAQ channel mapping**
- AO ch 0 → TF bank 1 - AO ch 1 → TF bank 2 - AO ch 2 → PF bank 1 - AO ch 3 → PF bank 2
